name: incorporated_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the entity incorporated (where is its registered head office)?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the entity's incorporation or registered head office (Japan: 本店又は主たる事務所); certificate of incorporation, company register.

name: managed_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the entity's effective management (central management and control) exercised?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the place of effective management: CN 实际管理机构 (EIT Law art. 2), HK normally managed or controlled (s50AAC), SG control and management of the business (s2); board minutes, location of senior management.

name: domicile_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the individual domiciled (permanent home, 住所)?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the individual's domicile: CN 住所 (IIT Law art. 1), JP 住所 (ITA art. 2); household registration, family and economic ties.

name: days_present
question: How many days was the individual present in the jurisdiction during the tax year that contains the payment date?
meaning: Days of presence in the tax year of the jurisdiction being tested (CN, TH: calendar year; HK: year of assessment; SG: the year preceding the year of assessment); immigration records.

name: days_present_two_years
question: How many days was the individual present in Hong Kong in the two consecutive years of assessment that include the current one?
meaning: Days of presence in Hong Kong over two consecutive years of assessment, one of them the current year (s50AAC(1)(a)(ii)(B)); immigration records.

name: ordinarily_resides
question: Does the individual ordinarily reside in the jurisdiction (a home there, not merely visiting)?
meaning: HK s50AAC(1)(a)(i) 'ordinarily resides in Hong Kong'; SG s2(1) 'resides in Singapore except for such temporary absences'; home, family, habitual abode.

name: residence_years
question: For how many continuous years up to the payment date has the individual had a place of residence (居所) in Japan?
meaning: Years of continuous 居所 in Japan (ITA art. 2(1)(iii): one year or more); residence records.

name: non_permanent_resident
question: Is the individual a non-permanent resident of Japan (no Japanese nationality and domicile or residence in Japan for five years or less within the last ten years)?
meaning: ITA art. 2(1)(iv) 非永住者; nationality and residence history.

name: holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payer's capital (voting shares where the clause says so) does the payee hold directly at the payment date?
meaning: Ratio of the payer's shares held directly by the payee, in %; shareholder register. The clause decides capital or voting shares.

name: holding_months
question: For how many months has the payee continuously held the shares at the payment date?
meaning: Months of continuous holding of the shares that carry the dividend, counted to the payment (or entitlement) date; share register, transfer documents.

name: payer_listed
question: Are the payer's shares listed on a stock exchange?
meaning: Payer's shares publicly issued and listed (CN EIT Reg. art. 83 公开发行并上市流通; JP SMA 9-3 上場株式等); exchange listing.

name: payee_listed
question: Is the payee a company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand?
meaning: TH Revenue Code s65 bis (10)(a) บริษัทจดทะเบียน (listed company); SET listing.

name: cross_holding
question: Does the payer hold shares in the payee, directly or indirectly?
meaning: TH s65 bis (10)(b): the paying company must not hold shares in the receiving company directly or indirectly; shareholder registers of both.

name: payer_industrial
question: Is the payer a company engaged in an industrial undertaking as defined in the Japan-Thailand convention?
meaning: JP-TH convention art. 10(2)(a) and the definition of industrial undertaking in art. 10; payer's business licence and accounts.

name: payer_tax_rate
question: What is the headline rate (%) of the income tax on company profits in the payer's jurisdiction at the time the dividend is received?
meaning: Applicable or highest rate of the tax on company profits in the payer's jurisdiction: HK s15N(6)(b) applicable rate, SG s13(9)(b) highest rate, TH RD 442 s4(2) rate of tax on net profit; the payer's tax law.

name: payer_etr
question: What is the payer's effective tax burden (%) on its profits for the year (tax actually borne divided by profits)?
meaning: Effective tax burden of the payer: CN 实际税负 (EIT Reg. art. 118), JP 租税負担割合 (SMA 66-6(5)); the payer's tax return and accounts.

name: payer_income_taxed
question: Were the profits out of which the dividend is paid (or the dividend itself) actually subject to income tax in the payer's jurisdiction?
meaning: SG s13(9)(a) income subject to tax; HK s15N(2)(a) income or underlying profits subject to a qualifying similar tax; TH RD 442 s4(2) dividend from taxed net profit; the payer's tax assessment.

name: payer_fie
question: Is the payer a foreign-invested enterprise (外商投资企业) in mainland China?
meaning: MoF/STA Announcement 2026 No. 27 item 1; the payer's business licence and foreign-investment registration.

name: mne_entity
question: Is the payee an MNE entity (a member of a multinational enterprise group) carrying on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong?
meaning: HK s15H(1) MNE entity, s15I(3)(a); group structure chart and consolidated accounts.

name: family_company
question: Is the payer a family company (同族会社: three or fewer shareholder groups holding more than 50%)?
meaning: JP CTA art. 2(x) 同族会社; shareholder register.

name: payer_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the payer resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the payer's residence, used for country lists (CN CFC white list); the payer's residence certificate.

name: resident_holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payer's shares (or votes, or dividend rights) is held in total by residents of the payee's jurisdiction?
meaning: CN EIT Reg. art. 117(1): resident enterprises and Chinese residents jointly hold more than 50%; JP SMA 66-6(2)(i): residents and domestic companies hold more than 50%; shareholder register of the payer.

name: paid_in_capital
question: What is the payee's paid-in capital at the end of the business year (JPY)?
meaning: JP CTA art. 66(2): the 19% rate applies only when capital is at most jp.final.sme_capital_max; company register.

name: parent_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the person that holds 100% of the payee, directly or indirectly, resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the payee's 100% parent (STA 2018 No. 9 item 3); group structure chart, shareholder registers.

name: parent_holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payee is held, directly or indirectly, by that parent?
meaning: Percentage of the payee's shares held by the parent named in parent_jur; shareholder register.

name: parent_holding_months
question: For how many months before the dividend has the parent held that percentage without interruption?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 5: the holding ratio must be met at all times during the 12 months before the dividend; share register.

name: parent_treaty_not_worse
question: If the parent received the dividend directly, would its treaty benefit be at least as good as the payee's?
meaning: Item 3: the parent is a 'qualifying person' when the treaty between the source and parent_jur gives the same or a better dividend benefit than the payee's treaty; compare the dividend_rate parameters of the two pairs. Computed from the parameters, not asked.

name: payee_listed_in_partner
question: Is the payee a company listed on a stock exchange in its own jurisdiction (the treaty partner)?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 4(2): a listed resident company is beneficial owner without the factor analysis; exchange listing.

name: payee_is_government
question: Is the payee the government of the treaty partner?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 4(1).

name: passes_on_within_12m
question: Is the payee obliged, by contract or by established practice, to pass on more than half of the dividend to a resident of a third jurisdiction within 12 months?
meaning: Unfavourable factor of STA 2018 No. 9 item 2(1) (parameters cn.outbound_wht.bo_pass_on_share_max, bo_pass_on_months); shareholder agreements, prior distributions, bank records.

name: substantive_business
question: Does the payee carry on substantive business activities (manufacturing, distribution, management, or substantive management of its investments)?
meaning: Factor of STA 2018 No. 9 item 2(2); functions performed and risks borne; accounts, staff.

name: employees_in_jurisdiction
question: How many employees does the payee have in its jurisdiction?
meaning: Factor for economic substance (HK s15K(2)) and for beneficial ownership; payroll records.

name: premises_in_jurisdiction
question: Does the payee have premises of its own in its jurisdiction, not only a registered or secretary's address?
meaning: Factor for economic substance (HK s15K(2)); lease, office records.

name: specified_cfc
question: Is the payer a specified foreign related company (paper company, cash box or blacklisted-jurisdiction company under SMA 66-6(2)(ii))?
meaning: JP SMA 66-6(2)(ii) 特定外国関係会社; the payer's staff, premises, assets and income composition.

name: tiers
question: Through how many tiers of foreign companies is the credited foreign tax borne (the payer itself is tier 1)?
meaning: CN Caishui 2017 No. 84 item 2: at most five tiers of foreign companies, each held 20% or more; group structure chart.

name: received_in_jurisdiction
question: Is the dividend received in (remitted into) the payee's jurisdiction?
meaning: Remittance basis: HK s15I(3)(a) received in Hong Kong; SG s10(1) received in Singapore from outside Singapore; TH s41 paragraph 2 brought into Thailand; JP ITA 7(1)(ii) paid in or remitted to Japan. In planning the candidate structure decides it; for a recorded transaction the bank record.

name: payer_resident
question: Is the payer resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: Output of that jurisdiction's residence cell applied to the payer (its incorporated_in and managed_in); computed by the flow evaluator, not asked.

name: payee_resident
question: Is the payee resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated (for a treaty rule: in the treaty partner)?
meaning: Output of the residence cell of the payee's jurisdiction applied to the payee; computed by the flow evaluator, not asked.

name: payer_low_tax
question: Is the payer's effective tax burden below half of the Chinese statutory rate?
meaning: payer_etr < cn.final.cit_rate x cn.cfc.low_tax_rate_share_max / 100 (EIT Reg. art. 118: below 50% of the 25% rate); computed from payer_etr and the two parameters, not asked.

name: other_taxable_income
question: What is the recipient's other net taxable income of the year, in the currency of the recipient's jurisdiction?
meaning: Net taxable income of the recipient for the year before adding this dividend, in the recipient jurisdiction's currency; sets the band of a schedule, also the HK two-tier and JP small-company schedules. Tax return of the previous year or a projection, labelled as such.

name: amount_payee_ccy
question: What is the gross dividend amount in the currency of the recipient's jurisdiction?
meaning: The dividend converted into the recipient jurisdiction's currency at the rate the recipient uses for its return; the library has no exchange rates, the conversion is the caller's. Used only by schedule rules.

name: concealment
question: Were facts concealed or disguised, or records falsified, in the return or withholding at issue?
meaning: Whether the understatement would be treated as evasion / fraud rather than an ordinary error: CN TCA art. 63, SG ITA s96, JP General Act s68. Selects the harsher penalty rules; unknown leaves the ceiling at the harsher figure.

name: negligence
question: Was the incorrect return made without reasonable excuse or through negligence?
meaning: SG ITA s95(2) fault standard (double penalty); the ordinary s95(1) penalty applies without fault.

name: overdue_months
question: How many months have passed since the payment deadline at the assessment date?
meaning: Months from the withholding / payment deadline to the date the exposure is assessed; the caller computes it from the deadline parameters and the assessment date. Drives time-dependent surcharges (HK s71(5A)).

name: voluntary_payment
question: Would the tax be paid voluntarily before any notice from the tax office and not in anticipation of an audit?
meaning: JP General Act s67(2): the non-payment additional tax falls from 10% to 5% for voluntary late payment.

name: return_filed
question: Was a return filed for the period in question?
meaning: TH Revenue Code: penalty of one time the tax on an assessment after a return (s22) versus two times where no return was filed (s26).

name: target_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the company whose shares are transferred resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the company transferred (the 'target'); set by the optimization layer for each transfer it evaluates.

name: target_in_jurisdiction
question: Is the company whose shares are transferred resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: True in the source cell (target_jur = cell jurisdiction), false in the transferor's home cell; set by eval_transfer, not asked.

name: transferor_resident
question: Is the transferor resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: Output of that jurisdiction's residence cell applied to the transferor (its transferor.* facts); computed by eval_transfer, not asked.

name: transferred_pct
question: What percentage of the company's share capital is transferred in this transaction (together with related persons in the same year)?
meaning: Share of the target's capital transferred; JP Cabinet Order art. 178(6)(ii) 5% test and treaty JP-SG art. 13(4)(b)(ii). Share transfer agreement.

name: property_rich_ratio
question: What percentage of the value of the company's shares derives, directly or indirectly, from immovable property situated in its jurisdiction?
meaning: Property-rich test of treaty Article 13 (50% or three-quarters) and of the CN group safe harbour (STA 2015 No. 7 item 6). Latest balance sheet or appraisal; 0 for a pure holding of operating companies without real estate.

name: indirect_transfer
question: Are the shares transferred those of a foreign holding company that itself holds the Chinese company, rather than the Chinese company's own shares?
meaning: Indirect transfer within STA 2015 No. 7 item 1; set by the move (which link of the chain is sold).

name: group_relation_pct
question: What percentage of the transferee does the transferor own (or vice versa, or both under a common parent), directly or indirectly?
meaning: Relation between transferor and transferee for the intra-group safe harbour of STA 2015 No. 7 item 6 (80%; 100% when property-rich). Group structure chart.

name: target_listed
question: Are the shares transferred listed on a recognised stock exchange and bought and sold on that exchange?
meaning: Listed-share exemptions: STA 2015 No. 7 item 5 (public market), treaty CN-HK art. 13(6), SG-TH art. 13(2). Exchange listing.

name: consideration_in_shares
question: Is the consideration for the transfer paid entirely in shares of the transferee or of a company it controls (not listed shares)?
meaning: STA 2015 No. 7 item 6(3): condition of the intra-group reorganisation safe harbour; an individual transferee or a cash deal fails it. Set by the planned deal; PLAN when undecided.

name: future_cn_tax_not_reduced
question: After this indirect transfer, would a later indirect transfer of the same Chinese taxable property bear Chinese income tax that is not lower than it would have borne without this transfer?
meaning: STA 2015 No. 7 item 6(2): condition of the intra-group reorganisation safe harbour. The optimization layer derives it by comparing the Chinese tax on a direct transfer of the Chinese company by the transferee with that by the transferor (treaty Article 13 position of each); PLAN when it cannot.
